explanation: Soya (soy) milk is curdled much like cheese, often with nigari, the bitter, mineral-rich liquid left after salt is extracted from seawater.

claims.text: Tofu is made by curdling soya milk and pressing the curds into blocks.
Tofu is not made from the milk of kidney beans, broad beans or butter beans.
Nigari, a common tofu coagulant, is the magnesium chloride-rich liquid left after salt is extracted from seawater.
